reasons.plausibility: Introducing pores into a metallic alloy almost invariably reduces strength and stiffness, and the claim that a porous structure can maintain or improve mechanical properties at 1000 °C without any strengthening mechanism is physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but the hypothesis itself is so implausible that the test is not scientifically useful.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a method (adding porosity) that is fundamentally detrimental to mechanical properties, especially at high temperature, and ignores well-established structure-property relationships.
